history.notes: First release. A short glance at your day in up to three lines, written by AI each hour from your weather, events, and tasks.
First release. Describe a clock in a few words and AI designs its background, colors, font, and date.
First release. A pixel cow that sleeps at night, dances to your music, and dresses for the weather, with a new thought written by AI every few hours.
First release. Fish, bubbles, and swaying weeds in deep blue water, with few, some, or many fish.
First release. Northern lights rippling over a starry sky in green, green and pink, or violet.
First release. Classic Breakout with walls that come back as rows, a pyramid, a checkerboard, or a heart.
First release. Two clocks for chess or any turn-based game. Tap your side on your phone to pass the turn, with tenths under 10 seconds.
First release. Up to six chores take turns among up to four people, daily or weekly, and you tap them done on your phone.
First release. Count the days to a trip, a birthday, or a festival, each taking a turn after the clock. On the day itself the cow celebrates.
First release. Roll one or two dice or flip a coin from your phone. The dice tumble and land, and two dice show their sum.
First release. Columns of glowing code falling at their own speeds, in any color you pick.
First release. Pieces fall, stack, and clear lines, with the lines cleared and the next piece beside the well.
First release. A Pomodoro timer on your whole mooboard. Four dots count your focus blocks, and a bar fills as each focus or break runs.
First release. A new fun fact every hour, from 400 facts each checked against a source.
First release. Tap a habit on your phone and watch the streak grow, with each habit's last 14 days as dots.
First release. Work and rest rounds for your workout, with WORK in red, REST in green, the round, the time left, and a bar.
First release. A new family friendly joke every day, with the setup first and then the punchline beside a grin.
First release. Slow blobs of lava rise and sink in a color you pick.
First release. A maze draws itself, then finds the way out.
Rebuilt as a highway racer with nitro boost, three lanes of traffic, and a choice of three tracks.
First release. Retro arcade racing with drift trails.
Rebuilt with a knight who crosses each floor to the stairs, opening chests and fighting skeletons, bats, and slimes. Pick the Crypt, the Lava Dungeon, or the Ice Cavern.
First release. A retro dungeon crawl with monsters.
First release. A skyline whose sky follows the time of day, with stars, the moon, and windows that light up through the evening.
First release. A sleep light that tells kids when to get up, with a dim moon all night and a bright sun at wake time.
Rebuilt as a sideways table with three bumpers, drop targets, and two flippers, on a choice of three tables. Dropping all three targets raises the multiplier.
First release. Arcade pinball with bumpers and ramps.
First release. A new quote every hour with who said it, from 398 quotes in the public domain.
First release. Rain runs down the glass with the city glowing behind it.
First release. Classic Snake, one apple at a time.
First release. Snow settles on a cozy cabin, a village, or pines, and a shake swirls it up again.
A new lander that sets down between jagged peaks. Fly in low, normal, or high gravity on the Moon, Mars, or Europa.
First release. Pilot a thrust rocket to the landing pads.
First release. Today's sunrise, sunset, and hours of daylight where you live, with the moon as it looks from your half of the world.
First release. Start a countdown from 1 to 30 minutes, add a minute, pause, or cancel, or run a stopwatch in tenths of a second.
First release. A new word and what it means every day, from 366 words written for mooboard.
